entries.0e09fb5e990755af: The business consists of six divisions: environmental impact assessment and environmental planning, environmental biology, numerical analysis, survey, environmental chemistry, and meteorology and coastal areas, and carries out work relating to environmental status surveys and phenomenon analysis, environmental impact assessment and environmental planning, environmental conservation, restoration and creation, and environmental risk assessment and management, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥15,951 million, the largest of the five reportable segments. In addition to the company, four consolidated subsidiaries, one non-consolidated subsidiary and three affiliates operate this business.
entries.224a45d700e739b7: This division conducts flood control planning that takes climate change into account, basin flood control measures, flood inundation projections, construction of support systems for dam water management and operation, and planning of coastal protection facilities and tsunami and storm surge countermeasures, among others. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,042 million.
entries.2899569274a8c245: Governments and public institutions of developing countries
entries.28b59f526706e743: This division conducts marine environmental surveys for the development of ports, airports and earth-and-sediment disposal sites, marine monitoring surveys for power generation facilities, marine environmental surveys using AUVs, research, development, design, manufacturing and operational support for AUVs, and soil contamination and waste surveys and countermeasures, among others. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,605 million.
entries.2c245bde34308ed1: This division conducts planning and design of river structures such as embankments and revetments, sluice gates, weirs, drainage pumping stations, retarding basins and floodways, seismic performance verification of river embankments, and work on sediment disaster countermeasures such as sabo dam design and sabo basic surveys, among others. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,759 million.
entries.35303036854f950b: This division conducts environmental impact assessments of currents and water quality in enclosed sea areas and lakes using numerical modeling, prediction and analysis of material cycles and fishery resources in water quality, sediment and ecosystems, studies using radar rain gauges, and analysis of climate projection datasets, among others. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥409 million.
entries.40a4a7d55f9b9396: This business relates to the design, construction and management of information systems. It builds cloud systems such as an AI-based dam low-water management support system, advanced flow observation systems using camera image analysis and debris flow detection systems, develops disaster-prevention systems using digital twins and AI, and provides operational support for Earth observation satellites. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥651 million. The company operates this business.
entries.4a68ca771013f1e0: Environmental Impact Assessment and Environmental Planning Division
entries.5a4699f4a90ced08: Government agencies such as the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, the Ministry of Defense and the Ministry of the Environment
entries.5c3adbb75ac748e3: This division conducts environmental impact assessment work for the construction of ports, airports, rivers, dams and roads and for renewable energy such as onshore and offshore wind power generation, surveys and studies on nature restoration and biodiversity and coexistence with nature, and design and seismic verification of seismic, tsunami, storm surge and high wave countermeasures for port facilities, among others. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,309 million.
entries.6a902d192da569d4: This division conducts design of general roads and motor-vehicle-only roads, design of road appurtenances and road structures, traffic accident countermeasures, traffic planning, undergrounding of utility lines, road facility inspection and disaster recovery work, among others. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,677 million.
entries.86b97e1383d801ab: This division distributes weather and marine information and content to smartphones, navigation systems and disaster-prevention GIS apps, provides weather forecasting services such as rainfall forecasts for dam management and road snow and ice forecasts, and conducts analysis of waves and coastal changes and monitoring, observation and analysis of tsunamis, storm surges and high waves, among others. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥401 million.
entries.8757db6e7a41ff3f: Government agencies such as the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism
entries.a778e4a91adea9ec: The business consists of four divisions: rivers, hydraulic structures, roads and bridges, and carries out work relating to planning, design and maintenance for the development and conservation of rivers, ports, airports and coastlines, the development and conservation of roads, bridges, transport and urban areas, and disaster prevention, mitigation and recovery, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥7,307 million. The company and its consolidated subsidiary Kureatekku Co., Ltd. operate this business.
entries.a797559fabace574: This division conducts design of steel and concrete bridges and others, maintenance and life-extension planning, inspection, diagnosis and assessment, and design work related to repair, reinforcement and renewal construction, among others. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,827 million.
entries.a8a73fdca09e821a: A comprehensive consulting company that handles environmental assessment, environmental surveys and analysis, and the planning and design of rivers, roads, and bridges.
entries.a8f689730bba57f4: This business relates to real estate leasing. It leases real estate, including an office building in Akasaka and the site of the former Osaka branch. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥157 million. The company operates this business.
entries.b60a3efd3ff4effe: This division conducts surveys and analysis of aquatic organisms ranging from inland waters such as rivers and lakes to tidal flats, seaweed beds, coral reefs, coastal areas and open ocean, surveys and analysis of the distribution and ecosystems of terrestrial plants and animals, conservation measures for rare species, and surveys using environmental DNA, among others. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,391 million.
entries.ed1f1b48ed3364ab: This business relates to overseas disaster-prevention measures, infrastructure management, and environmental conservation and creation. It carries out work relating to waste management, mercury management, water quality conservation of lakes, conservation of marine and coastal environments, climate change countermeasures, water resource management and flood countermeasures, development of port-related infrastructure, and strengthening of disaster-prevention capacity in developing countries, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥548 million. The company and its consolidated subsidiary Ides Co., Ltd. operate this business.
entries.f29e42a5c6d380af: This division conducts measurement and analysis of hazardous chemical substances in water quality, sediment, air quality and soil, measurement and analysis and development of analytical methods for dioxins and organic fluorine compounds (PFAS), environmental risk assessment of chemical substances, and functional evaluation and component analysis of foods, among others. External revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,833 million.
